claims: Jaxon Smith-Njigba signed a four-year, $168.6 million contract extension with the Seattle Seahawks on March 23, 2026.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba's contract extension makes him the highest-paid wide receiver in NFL history.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba's contract extension averages $42.15 million annually.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba's contract extension includes $120.06 million total guaranteed money.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba's contract extension has $69.13 million fully guaranteed at signing.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba's contract extension includes a $35 million signing bonus.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba's contract extension includes a $30 million option bonus in 2027.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba's contract extension includes an option bonus in 2029.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba is locked with the Seattle Seahawks through the 2031 season.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba's contract surpasses Ja'Marr Chase's previous record for wide receiver contracts.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba was named Offensive Player of the Year in the 2025 season.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba recorded 119 receptions in the 2025 season.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba recorded 1,793 yards in the 2025 season.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba recorded 10 touchdowns in the 2025 season.
The Seattle Seahawks exercised Jaxon Smith-Njigba's fifth-year option for 2027 just before the extension.
